title: Build a bakery website from scratch
prompt: Build a website for a small bakery: menu, opening hours, online orders.
about: A whole small product from an empty repo: menu with allergens and stock, ordering into 15-minute pickup slots, cancelling, Portuguese pages, an owner's admin area with CSV export, and a JSON API. Sized so one agent needs a long time and many agents can split it.
starter: scripts/lab/scenarios/bakery/starter (a product brief in README.md, a stub server, one smoke test)

profile.dependencyChain: storage + seed data -> API routes and validation -> pages and admin pages -> tests
profile.note: first guesses by qb5; greenfield: all work starts from one stub file, so early tasks collide on server.js unless the plan sets up structure first
